tickets.title: Prepare Sale Liquidity Staging Plan
tickets.text: Prepare a staging plan for Julian Maplesprocket outlining how the business‑sale cash will be allocated to household reserves, tax reserves, renovation funds, debt decisions, and investment tranches.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-liquidity staging plan by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Prepare Preferred Equity Rollover Review
tickets.text: Prepare a plain‑language review for Julian Maplesprocket of the $1.5 million preferred‑equity rollover into Copper Firefly Systems, covering liquidity limits, dividend terms, redemption rights, and concentration risk.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that preferred-equity rollover review by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA Sale‑Tax Projection Package
tickets.text: Prepare a tax projection package for Julian Maplesprocket with Alma Dewspindle of Silver Marmot Tax Partners, estimating federal, Oregon, basis, installment, escrow, and shareholder‑note treatment.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA sale-tax projection package by 2025-01-07.

tickets.title: Model Shareholder Note Payoff Treatment
tickets.text: Model the $380,000 shareholder note payoff for Julian Maplesprocket separately from equity proceeds to enable the advisory team and CPA to distinguish repayment cash from taxable sale consideration.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to model the shareholder note payoff treatment by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Clarify Retention Bonus Pool Variance
tickets.text: Clarify the variance in the employee retention bonus pool reported by Copper Firefly Systems for Julian Maplesprocket to determine its impact on net proceeds and working‑capital adjustments.
tickets.evidence: Clarification of the retention bonus pool variance is needed by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Prepare Escrow Holdback Reserve Analysis
tickets.text: Prepare an analysis for Julian Maplesprocket that models a liquidity reserve scenario excluding escrow release proceeds to assess cash availability before escrow amounts are received.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the escrow holdback reserve analysis by 2025-01-13.

tickets.title: Verify Incoming Wire Capacity and Instructions
tickets.text: Verify the incoming‑wire processing capacity and receiving instructions at Teacup Comet Bank for the expected sale proceeds for Julian Maplesprocket.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions by 2025-01-02.

tickets.title: Finalize Consulting Agreement Economics
tickets.text: Finalize the economics of the post‑sale consulting agreement for Julian Maplesprocket with Copper Firefly Systems, including compensation, expense reimbursement, termination, and non‑compete terms.
tickets.evidence: Final consulting agreement economics are needed by 2025-01-09.

tickets.title: Prepare Post‑Sale Investment Policy
tickets.text: Prepare an investment policy for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket after the business sale, reflecting staged deployment, cash comfort floor, tax exposure, and fossil‑fuel screening preferences.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the post-sale investment policy by 2025-01-22.

tickets.title: Review Insurance Transition After Sale
tickets.text: Review the transition of Julian and Priya Maplesprocket’s insurance coverage, including life, disability, umbrella, and key‑person policies, following the business sale.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to review the insurance transition after the business sale by 2025-01-15.

tickets.title: Complete Estate Liquidity and Fiduciary Review
tickets.text: Complete a review for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket of estate liquidity needs and fiduciary roles, assessing whether the 2016 plan aligns with the increased liquidity from the sale.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete an estate liquidity and fiduciary review by 2025-01-17.

tickets.title: Prepare Residency and Sourcing Support File
tickets.text: Prepare a residency and sourcing support file for Julian Maplesprocket to assist Alma Dewspindle of Silver Marmot Tax Partners with the sale‑year tax analysis.
tickets.evidence: need for a residency and sourcing support file for the CPA’s sale-year tax analysis by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare Charitable Funding Structure Comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison for Julian Maplesprocket of charitable funding structures, evaluating amounts, timing, appreciated securities, and integration with the business‑sale liquidity.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the charitable funding structure comparison by 2025-01-14.

tickets.title: Prepare Updated Funds‑Flow Schedule
tickets.text: Prepare an updated funds‑flow schedule for Julian Maplesprocket separating gross consideration, escrow holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees.
tickets.evidence: An updated funds-flow schedule is needed to separate gross consideration, holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Obtain Equity Ledger and Option‑Cancellation Records
tickets.text: Obtain the final capitalization table, equity ledger, and option‑cancellation records for Buttonwood Balloon Components needed for Julian Maplesprocket’s sale proceeds verification.
